pms.mandate: Opportunistic macro. Can swing big or grind singles/doubles. May hedge.
pms.thesis: The book stays flat. The Fed is still discussing hikes while yields fell on a haven bid, so the next leg in the dollar is unresolved. Dollar-yen sits on intervention risk, the Canada short fights the policy gap, euro-aussie fights firm crude, and the euro is already a crowded dollar short.

pms.mandate: Preservation and consistency first. Smaller sizes, high hurdles, quick de-risking. No-trade is valid.
